python3 -c "
import json,os,shutil,time
J='/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr/decisions.jsonl'
shutil.copy(J,J+'.bak_replay_'+time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S'))
raw=open(J,'rb').read().split(b'\n')
tail_empty = raw and raw[-1]==b''
lines=raw[:-1] if tail_empty else raw
drop=set()
for i,ln in enumerate(lines):
    if i<419: continue
    r=json.loads(ln)
    if r.get('by')=='auto' and r.get('id') in range(227,233) and r.get('kind') in ('tp1','be','trail_start'): drop.add(i)
print('total',len(lines),'drop',len(drop),'range',min(drop),max(drop))
assert drop==set(range(419,437)), 'unexpected set'
keep=[l for i,l in enumerate(lines) if i not in drop]
sz0=os.path.getsize(J)
tmp=J+'.tmp'; open(tmp,'wb').write(b'\n'.join(keep)+b'\n')
assert os.path.getsize(J)==sz0, 'file changed during cleanup'
st=os.stat(J); os.chown(tmp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid); os.chmod(tmp,st.st_mode & 0o777)
os.replace(tmp,J)
print('done',len(keep))
" 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'; ls -la /opt/trading-bot/positions_regr/decisions.jsonl* | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
